name: 连帽袋鼠兜宽松休闲卫衣款
description: 暖白床品平铺连帽卫衣：黑标版条、走线微距、四色宫格与双联对比收口

styleLock.direction: warm home-staged menswear pullover commerce, domestic flat-lay staging with a heavy ink title band and one vermilion close screen
styleLock.backgroundSystem: rumpled warm-cream cotton bedding #F0EBE2 as the primary flat-lay field, matte slate field #8E9199 for the lifestyle and one detail screen, deep ink #12141A title bands and info panels, one full vermilion #CE3F2C closing screen, one warm-paper card board #E4DCCD for the seam macro; backgrounds alternate shot by shot, never a gradient, never an outdoor or shop interior
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm window light from the upper left at 4000K-4300K with a large bounce card on the shadow side; fabric shadows stay gentle and directional, one skimming highlight sweeps across seams and ribbing to open the texture; no harsh specular, no cool cast, no rim glow
styleLock.surfaceSystem: rumpled warm-cream cotton bedding #F0EBE2 with real pillow folds, warm-paper card board #E4DCCD, matte slate board #8E9199 and a low blank ink #12141A riser for info screens; every surface is matte and fabric-true, contact shadow only where the garment touches
styleLock.typography: one heavy geometric sans-serif family for title bands with wide letter spacing, paired with a light sans-serif for short labels; rendered copy is limited to one headline plus two or three short labels per screen, all carried by placeholders, no serif, no script, no brush lettering, no vertical type column
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline outline check capsules and thin divider rules only, drawn in vermilion #CE3F2C or ink #12141A at one hairline weight, plus one blank rounded button plate and one blank offer rail with empty cells; no filled 3D badges, no shields, no cart or membership marks
styleLock.presentationRules: the garment is always spread in the same symmetric splay with the hood opened flat, the front pouch facing the lens and both cuffs turned to show the rib wall; scale and centring stay identical across all flat-lay screens, macro screens keep one construction zone only, and the product never overlaps rendered type
noDrift: no colour palette changes beyond #F0EBE2, #12141A, #CE3F2C, #8E9199 and #E4DCCD
no mixed fonts and no serif, script or brush lettering
no hanger, no mannequin, no model, no face and no hands
no outdoor scenery, shop interior, gradient sweep or random background
no inconsistent lighting and no cool blue cast
no invented fabric composition, gram weight, measurement, test or credential numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm home-staged menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of rumpled warm-cream cotton bedding #F0EBE2, deep ink title band #12141A, one vermilion accent #CE3F2C and one matte slate field #8E9199, with a warm-paper card board #E4DCCD reserved for seam macros; soft warm window key from the upper left at 4000K-4300K with a large bounce fill, gentle directional fabric shadows and one skimming highlight across seams and ribbing; one heavy geometric sans-serif for title bands plus a light sans-serif for short labels; hairline outline check capsules, thin divider rules, one blank rounded button plate and one blank offer rail as the only graphic components; matte bedding, paper and slate surfaces only, contact shadow where the garment touches; garment always spread in the same symmetric splay with hood opened flat and pouch facing the lens, stable scale and centring; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no hanger or mannequin or model, no outdoor or shop background, no gradient sweep, no inconsistent lighting, no invented composition, weight, measurement, test or credential numbers.
